shortDescription: Copper edged lower after hotter-than-expected US inflation data led traders to increase bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes, according to Bloomberg.

title: Copper Edges Lower as Hot US Inflation Lifts Fed Rate-Hike Bets
